note: Guthrie County Conservation park, 81 acres on the South Raccoon River between Panora and Stuart. Electric RV sites plus primitive camping. Disc golf, canoe access (South Raccoon River Water Trail). Satellite shows a continuous treeline screen between the camp loop and the river, so sites are not on the water. --Claude
summary: County page confirms 45 electric sites, showers, flush toilets, dump, FCFS, $20; count and potable water added. Amperage and season unstated. Not waterfront holds.
flags: WATERFRONT holds at not waterfront: loops sit ~50-80 m from the South Raccoon behind a continuous tree belt and the campground road. River here is about 15-30 m bank to bank including gravel bars, so a creek by width even if the trees opened. The county confirms South Raccoon; stored evidence's 'Middle Raccoon' is wrong.
PHONE: the county page gives 641-755-3061 for shelter reservations (GCCB); stored 515-523-1789 wasn't on the page text I read. Not changed. Guthrie County's own conservation page answered 403.
